title: 93 Needlerush Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 93 Needlerush Drive is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Tucked in the desirable Lake District of WaterColor, 93 Needlerush Drive offers a serene 30A retreat with timeless style and thoughtful design. Just steps from the peaceful Frog Pool and a short ride to the WaterColor Beach Club, this home provides the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and connection.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 12 Passes Included Private Pool (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) 6 Adult Bikes Included Parking for 2 Vehicles Detached Carriage House Large Screened Porch Steps From Frog Pool 3-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 6-Minute Bike Ride to the WaterColor Beach Club 6-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Step inside to discover a beautifully appointed coastal home designed for gathering and relaxation. The open-concept great room features rich hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and inviting furnishings that create a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The gourmet kitchen offers premium stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and custom cabinetry, perfect for preparing family meals or casual breakfasts before a day at the beach. A spacious dining area seats six, with additional seating at the kitchen bar for informal dining. The first floor also includes a serene primary suite with a king bed and a spa-inspired private bath complete with double vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. A convenient half bath completes the main level. Upstairs, two additional king guest rooms each offer private en-suite bathrooms, while a cheerful bunk area with two sets of twin bunks provides the perfect setup for kids or extra guests.The detached carriage house offers a private and peaceful retreat with a king bed, full bathroom, and kitchenette, ideal for extended family or guests seeking extra privacy. Outside, enjoy your own backyard oasis complete with a sparkling pool and furnished deck, perfect for sunbathing or evening relaxation. Complimentary pool heating is available seasonally. The large, screened porch provides a comfortable space for outdoor dining or morning coffee. With six adult bikes included, you can easily explore the scenic trails, neighborhood parks, and coastal pathways that make WaterColor so special.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking TubHalf BathKitchen, Living Room, Dining AreaSecond Floor Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower ComboGuest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower ComboBunk Area: Two Sets of Twin Bunk Beds (4)Carriage House Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower ComboLife in WaterColor The Lake District offers a peaceful escape while keeping you close to WaterColor’s most beloved amenities. Spend days relaxing at the exclusive Beach Club, enjoying the lazy river and slides at Camp WaterColor, or exploring the community’s scenic nature trails and coastal dune lakes. With Seaside just a short ride away, you’ll have easy access to boutique shopping, dining, and 30A’s coastal charm. 93 Needlerush Drive invites you to experience the best of WaterColor living with exceptional comfort, convenience, and style—brought to you by Sanders Beach Rentals. Guests may rent a cart exclusively through The Electric Cart Company. Please note that WaterColor allows only one electric cart per home, and rentals are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Advance reservations are strongly recommended, especially during peak seasons.
